questions.stem: Vectors p and q are parallel. If p = (6, −4) and q = (k, 10), what is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Parallel vectors are scalar multiples. Comparing y-components: 10 = −4 × s, so s = −2.5. Then k = 6 × (−2.5) = −15. The negative scalar means q points in the opposite direction to p.

questions.stem: If 1/2 a = (3, −1), what is the magnitude of a?
questions.explanation: If 1/2 a = (3, −1), then a = (6, −2). Magnitude of a = sqrt(6² + (−2)²) = sqrt(36 + 4) = sqrt(40) = 2sqrt(10). Note that sqrt(40) and 2sqrt(10) are the same value, but 2sqrt(10) is the simplified surd form.

questions.stem: Point M is the midpoint of AB. If OA = a and OB = b, express OM in terms of a and b.
questions.explanation: OM = OA + AM = a + 1/2 AB = a + 1/2(b − a) = a + 1/2 b − 1/2 a = 1/2 a + 1/2 b = 1/2(a + b). This is a standard result: the position vector of the midpoint is the average of the endpoint position vectors.
